Tasks: Tasks are actions performed by persons which interact with the ride. They exclude misuse.
Interacting with the amusement ride or device
Watching the ride from the queue
Evacuate the amusement ride or device
Hazards: Hazards are devices, mechanisms, actions, objects etc., that have the potential to cause harm.
Vehicle deceleration at the bottom of the drop
Tower structure next to the vehicle path
Situations: A hazardous situation is a person, in a specific position and state during a specific ride phase, where a hazard could reach them.
rider seated in the vehicle while it is raised and dropped
maintainer inside the tower with the vehicle raised
rider stranded at height awaiting evacuation
rider seated in the vehicle while it is raised and dropped
maintainer with an electrical enclosure open
rider sitting down as the restraint closes
maintainer inside the tower with the vehicle raised
maintainer with an electrical enclosure open
bystander at the queue line fence
rider reaching an arm outside the vehicle
operator at the ride control panel
Harmful Events: harm: physical injury or damage to health. harmful event: the process in which the hazardous situation leads to harm.
Suspension cable snaps and the vehicle free-falls; spinal injury

Shock absorber limits impact to a survivable level

Mitigations: Eliminate risk, or reduce risk using Design or Administrative methods
Daily inspection of the suspension cable by personnel trained in cable inspection
Second, redundant cable able to support the vehicle on its own
Shock absorber at the bottom of the drop shaft limits deceleration
Restraint actuator force limited by a pressure regulator
Fixed guard enclosing the drive belt and pulleys
Mechanical locking pin holds the vehicle at height for maintenance
Lockout/tagout procedure before any maintenance task
Loose articles collected at the station before boarding
Mesh screens on the vehicle keep dropped objects inside
Vehicle side walls and clearance envelope keep arms clear of the tower
Manual brake release lowers the vehicle under gravity, removing the need to evacuate at height
Mains terminals shrouded behind finger-safe covers
